items.title: Everything Announced At The September 2026 PlayStation State Of Play
items.description: PlayStation presented its Fall State of Play, showcasing new game announcements, updates on known projects, and everything in between. If you missed the live broadcast, here’s a quick summary of every announcement, including trailers and links to our full write-ups for applicable titles. After reading this, be sure to check out our recap of every announcement from the State of Play Japan presentation that aired directly after this showcase.  Resident EvilDirector Zach Cregger'

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Limited Edition DualSense Wireless Controllers Revealed
